long-division-asymptote.alt: The graph of y = (x squared + 3x + 5)/(x + 1) in two branches on either side of the vertical asymptote x = -1, with the dashed line y = x + 2. The curve hugs the line far from x = -1; at x = 3 a vertical segment marks the gap 3/(x + 1). Long division gives x + 2 + 3/(x + 1).
